// Fixture for tests/record-citations.test.ts: source the literal scan must fail on.
// It is text, not compiled. Two defects and two things the scan must leave alone:
//   1. a message that cites a decision record;
//   2. a template whose static text cites a design record;
//   3. a clean message;
//   4. citations inside comments, which are where they belong.
function fixture(name: string): string[] {
  return [
    'The fixture story is refused (ADR-999 D2) — fix its config.',
    `\`${name}\` is not loaded (given 8). Name what ${name /* ADR-1 in a comment is fine */} is.`,
    // A clean message: the scan must not flag it. ADR-2 in this comment is fine.
    'A clean message; nothing to cite.',
  ];
}
